attribution.title: Anne Frank statue (Merwedeplein) - reconstruction from photographs
attribution.author: Map Recall; sculpture by Jet Schepp (2005); figure reconstructed from photographs by Christian Michelides, Ceescamel
attribution.modifications: Figure reconstructed (TRELLIS.2 multi-view) from Wikimedia Commons photographs: "Anne Frank-Denkmal Amsterdam 03.jpg" by Christian Michelides (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Anne_Frank-Denkmal_Amsterdam_03.jpg); "Anne Frank 2019, Merwedeplein (3).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Anne_Frank_2019,_Merwedeplein_(3).jpg); "Anne Frank 2019, Merwedeplein (1).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Anne_Frank_2019,_Merwedeplein_(1).jpg); "Anne Frank-Denkmal Amsterdam 02.jpg" by Christian Michelides (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Anne_Frank-Denkmal_Amsterdam_02.jpg). Decimated to about 6,000 triangles per figure in the kit's material, no photo colour; plinth, pier and setting are the original low-poly kit model. Provenance: scripts/sculptures/rebuild-sources/anne-frank-merwedeplein.json.
